# 1. Load results

```{python}
#| label: load
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.rcParams.update({
    "text.usetex":     True,
    "font.family":     "serif",
    "font.size":       9,
    "axes.titlesize":  10,
    "axes.labelsize":  10,
    "legend.fontsize": 8,
    "text.latex.preamble": r"\usepackage{amsmath}\usepackage{amssymb}",
})

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("./lib")))
import sweep_runner as sr

OUT          = Path("./sweep/runs/stage1_universals")
results_csv  = OUT / "results.csv"
decision_txt = OUT / "decision.txt"
traces_dir   = OUT / "traces"

assert results_csv.exists(), f"Run `python sweep/bin/run_stage1.py` first — {results_csv} not found."
df = pd.read_csv(results_csv).sort_values(["oxide_dispersion", "t_oxide_um", "beta_deg"]).reset_index(drop=True)

print(f"{len(df)} simulations in results.csv")
df.head(10)[["t_oxide_um", "beta_deg", "oxide_dispersion",
             "Rdet_chi2_red", "Rdet_RMSE", "Rdet_pearson_r"]].round(4)
```

# 2. Heatmaps — χ²_red over (t_oxide, β) per oxide dispersion

```{python}
#| label: heatmaps

oxides = sorted(df["oxide_dispersion"].unique())
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, len(oxides), figsize=(5*len(oxides), 4.5), constrained_layout=True)
if len(oxides) == 1:
    ax = [ax]

for i, oxide in enumerate(oxides):
    sub = df[df["oxide_dispersion"] == oxide]
    pivot = sub.pivot(index="t_oxide_um", columns="beta_deg", values="Rdet_chi2_red")
    im = ax[i].imshow(np.log10(pivot.values), aspect="auto", origin="lower",
                      cmap="viridis_r")
    ax[i].set_xticks(range(len(pivot.columns)))
    ax[i].set_xticklabels([f"{b:g}" for b in pivot.columns])
    ax[i].set_yticks(range(len(pivot.index)))
    ax[i].set_yticklabels([f"{t:g}" for t in pivot.index])
    ax[i].set_xlabel(r"$\beta\;[^{\circ}]$")
    ax[i].set_ylabel(r"$t_{\mathrm{oxide}}\;[\mu\mathrm{m}]$")
    title_oxide = oxide.replace("_", r"\_")
    ax[i].set_title(rf"$\log_{{10}} \chi^2_{{\mathrm{{red}}}}(R_{{\mathrm{{det}}}})$ — {title_oxide}")
    cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax[i])
    cbar.set_label(r"$\log_{10}\,\chi^2_{\mathrm{red}}$")
    # mark the per-oxide minimum
    j_t, j_b = np.unravel_index(np.argmin(pivot.values), pivot.shape)
    ax[i].plot(j_b, j_t, marker="*", ms=18, color="white", mec="red", mew=1.5)

plt.show()
```

# 3. Best configuration overall

```{python}
#| label: best
best_idx = df["Rdet_chi2_red"].idxmin()
best = df.loc[best_idx]
print(f"Best config (argmin χ²_red across all {len(df)} runs):")
print(f"  t_oxide          = {best['t_oxide_um']:.3f} µm")
print(f"  beta             = {best['beta_deg']:g}°")
print(f"  oxide_dispersion = {best['oxide_dispersion']}")
print(f"  χ²_red(R_det)    = {best['Rdet_chi2_red']:.2f}")
print(f"  RMSE             = {best['Rdet_RMSE']:.4f}")
print(f"  Pearson r        = {best['Rdet_pearson_r']:.4f}")
print()
print("Top 5 by χ²_red:")
top = df.nsmallest(5, "Rdet_chi2_red")[
    ["t_oxide_um", "beta_deg", "oxide_dispersion",
     "Rdet_chi2_red", "Rdet_RMSE", "Rdet_pearson_r"]
].round(4)
print(top.to_string(index=False))
```

# 4. Best curve vs experiment

```{python}
#| label: best-curve
from scipy.interpolate import interp1d

cfg_best = sr.SimConfig(
    period_um=12.9, A_um=1.5,
    t_oxide_um=float(best["t_oxide_um"]),
    oxide_dispersion=str(best["oxide_dispersion"]),
    theta_deg=30.0, phi_sim_deg=89.0,
    harmonics=39, slices=50,
    beta_deg=float(best["beta_deg"]),
    wavelengths_um=np.arange(3.0, 25.0, 0.25),
)
stem = cfg_best.filename_stem()
avg_best = pd.read_csv(traces_dir / stem / f"AVG_{stem}.csv")

EXP_DIR = Path("../data/experimental")
exp_files = sorted(EXP_DIR.glob("12-3_30_0_*.CSV"))
exp_repeats = []
for f in exp_files:
    raw = pd.read_csv(f, header=None, names=["wn", "R_pct"])
    raw = raw[raw["R_pct"] > 0].copy()
    raw["lambda_um"] = 1e4 / raw["wn"]
    raw["R"] = raw["R_pct"] / 100.0
    raw = raw.sort_values("lambda_um").reset_index(drop=True)
    exp_repeats.append((raw["lambda_um"].values, raw["R"].values))

lam_sim = avg_best["x"].values
R_stack = np.array([
    interp1d(l, r, bounds_error=False, fill_value=np.nan, assume_sorted=True)(lam_sim)
    for l, r in exp_repeats
])
R_exp_mean = np.nanmean(R_stack, axis=0)
R_exp_std  = np.nanstd(R_stack, axis=0, ddof=1)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.5), constrained_layout=True)
ax.fill_between(lam_sim, R_exp_mean - R_exp_std, R_exp_mean + R_exp_std,
                color="C2", alpha=0.20)
ax.plot(lam_sim, R_exp_mean, color="C2", lw=2.0, label=r"$\langle R \rangle_{\mathrm{exp}}\!\pm\!\sigma$")
ax.plot(avg_best["x"], avg_best["R_det"], color="black", lw=2.0,
        label=rf"$\langle R_{{\mathrm{{det}}}} \rangle_{{\mathrm{{sim}}}}\;(t_{{\mathrm{{ox}}}}={best['t_oxide_um']:.2f}, \beta={best['beta_deg']:g}^{{\circ}})$")
ax.set_xlabel(r"$\lambda \;[\mu\mathrm{m}]$")
ax.set_ylabel(r"$R$")
ax.set_title(r"Best Tier-1 universal — sample SS\_12-3, $\theta=30^\circ$, $\varphi_{\mathrm{exp}}=0^\circ$")
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.4)
ax.legend(loc="lower right", framealpha=0.85)
plt.show()
```

# 6. Safety rail check

```{python}
#| label: safety-rail
chi2_min = float(df["Rdet_chi2_red"].min())
print(f"Best χ²_red = {chi2_min:.2f}")
if chi2_min > 5:
    print("\n⚠  Best χ²_red ≫ 1.  Per DISTANCE.md §6, the bottleneck is structural,")
    print("    not in Tier-2 geometry. Most likely diagnosis: the Cr2O3 phonon model")
    print("    (k(λ) extrapolation outside its 0.3–2.5 µm fit range — see ANALYSIS.md §4).")
    print("    Recommendation: do not proceed to Stage 2 until this is addressed.")
elif chi2_min > 1:
    print("\n→ Best χ²_red is above 1 but tractable. Stage 2 (per-sample geometry) might close")
    print("  the gap. Proceed with caution.")
else:
    print("\n✓ Best χ²_red ≤ 1 — simulation is consistent with experimental scatter.")
    print("  Stage 2 (per-sample geometry refinement) will only sharpen things.")
```
